label: best-effort decode, refit after b1n/b1n2: 15 static blocks (3-9 SYCL0, 23-30 SYCL1), 27 pinned host (88 GiB, the measured safe load), MTP, t 24, -ub/-b 2048

files.note: 4 shards on the SN850X; -lm none: CPU experts in the SYCL pinned host buffer

note: ONE change vs b1n: -ub/-b 2048 so the compute buffers fit beside 15 static blocks (b1n OOMed on device memory at ub 4096). Fewer static blocks would raise the pinned host buffer past what odie survives (b1n2 ~94 GiB livelocked the box; b1n 88 GiB loaded). Pinned memory is driver memory (gpu_active): a userspace watchdog in arm2.sh kills the server when MemAvailable - CmaFree < 8 GiB

gpu_split.note: planner card order: [B70 4c:00.0 = SYCL1, B70 23:00.0 = SYCL0]. banks = static expert blocks at the planner mean layer size + half the moe cache each (--moe-cache-mib splits like the layers); GPU0 carries the op-offload uploads (all host-expert prefill runs there), so it gets fewer static blocks and the larger fixed share
gpu_split.fixed_note: MEASURED b1n 07:02Z: fixed parts (dense + KV/RS + compute) SYCL1 (4c) 8235 MiB, SYCL0 (23) 8988 MiB

gate_unknown_reason: vram_peak UNKNOWN (30.39 + margin 0-2.25 of 31.89 on SYCL1): the margin band predates the measured compute buffers, which the post figure now holds. b1n died in a dev2dev_memcpy (MEASURED server.log, ggml-sycl.cpp:943) during warm-up with SYCL1 at 31.39 GiB; -ub 2048 frees ~1.7 GiB of SYCL1 compute (ESTIMATE: half of 3404 MiB), leaving ~2.2 GiB for the warm-up copies. A device OOM is a clean server exit, not a box risk.
